rows.notes: The cited work is a PRISMA systematic review with bibliometric analysis (VOSviewer term co-occurrence, frequency counts of 85 articles). It reports no own field, laboratory or survey data on thermal imaging/CWSI supporting irrigation timing or zoning, nor on fusion of thermal and multispectral data separating heat from nutrient stress. It only summarises that 32 reviewed studies used CWSI and that 60% combined thermal with multispectral imagery; the claimed effects are discussed from other studies, not demonstrated by this one. Q1 'no' therefore Q2-Q9 'no'.
